paragraphs: Rabbi Zakkai of Alexandria asked: Jerusalem Talmud, Naarah Shenitpattatah, halakhah 6. He knew when the water was sweet (see above, Rabbi Mana bar Tanchum). Jerusalem Talmud, Yevamot, Almanah LeKohen, halakhah 5:“Rabbi Zakkai, Rabbi Alexandria, sent a question: an Ammonite convert’s daughter ….” It should read Rabbi Zakkai of Alexandria.
